title: 3 Cities, 2,600 km: China's First-Timer Bullet-Train Loop | China Travel Expert
description:
The easiest way to see China on a first trip: three cities — Beijing, Xi'an, Shanghai — linked by high-speed rail in about 2,600 km.

Start in Beijing for the Great Wall and the old imperial capital. Ride roughly 1,216 km to Xi'an (under six hours) for China's ancient heart and the buried Terracotta Army. Then about 1,380 km on to Shanghai, where old China meets a neon skyline. Trains run at up to 300 km/h, so the travel days are short.

🧭 Expert Tip: High-speed rail seats open around 15 days out and popular runs fill up — book 10+ days ahead, and pick morning departures so you arrive with the afternoon free.

三座城、约2600公里、一趟高铁：北京看长城，西安看兵马俑，上海看天际线——车票提前一周多订。
